datasets.name: tenders
datasets.description: One row per tender: a row of the load table. Carries the names a metric can be grouped or filtered by.

fields.name: customer_name
fields.description: The customer: the parent account that the shipping site on the tender rolls up to. Revenue and loads belong to this account.

fields.name: shipper_site_name
fields.description: The shipping site on the tender. A site is not the customer; several sites roll up to one customer and a site does not always carry the customer's name.

fields.name: bill_to_party_name
fields.description: Whoever pays the invoice. It may be a shared accounts payable office or a freight payment firm paying for several customers. A bill-to party is not the customer.

fields.name: carrier_type
fields.description: The carrier type code on the carrier record.

fields.name: is_cross_border
fields.description: The cross-border flag on the tender.

fields.name: rated_currency
fields.description: The currency code the tender was rated in.

fields.name: equipment_type
fields.description: The equipment type code on the tender.

datasets.name: loads
datasets.description: One row per load: one shipment moved for a customer, counted once, from its first tender. Test rows and voided rows are not loads.

fields.name: booked_date
fields.description: The UTC date the load's first tender was created.

datasets.name: deliveries
datasets.description: One row per delivered load, dated by the calendar day of arrival at the final delivery stop on the clock at that stop.

fields.name: delivered_date
fields.description: The calendar day the load arrived at its final delivery stop, on the local clock at that stop.

fields.name: arrived_on_time
fields.description: True when the truck arrived at the final delivery stop at or before the end of the appointment window, both on the facility's local clock.

fields.name: shipper_delayed
fields.description: True when the load has a delay the shipper caused.

fields.name: has_signed_pod
fields.description: True when a signed proof of delivery is on file for the load.

dialects.expression: case when arrived_on_time then 1 else 0 end
case when arrived_on_time or not shipper_delayed then 1 else 0 end
case when not arrived_on_time and not shipper_delayed then 1 else 0 end
case when not has_signed_pod then 1 else 0 end

datasets.name: financial_documents
datasets.description: One row per invoice, credit memo or canceled-load fee, in US dollars, dated by the invoice date, the credit date or the fee date.

fields.name: document_date
fields.description: The invoice date, the credit date or the fee date.

fields.name: document_currency
fields.description: The currency code the document was issued in. Amounts in every metric are already converted to US dollars.

dialects.expression: case when document_type = 'invoice' then 1 else 0 end

datasets.name: portal_shipments
datasets.description: One row per shipment the customer portal shows as delivered, dated by the delivery date the portal shows.

fields.name: portal_delivered_date
fields.description: The delivery date the customer portal shows.

dialects.expression: case when portal_on_time then 1 else 0 end

metrics.name: loads_booked
metrics.description: Loads booked. A load is one shipment moved for a customer, counted once from its first tender. A re-tender is not a second load, and test rows and voided rows are not loads. A canceled load was a load and counts as booked. Dated by the UTC date of the first tender.

metrics.name: delivered_loads
metrics.description: Loads delivered: the carrier reported the final delivery. Only real loads count, never test rows or voided rows, and a re-tendered load is delivered once, by the carrier that hauled it. Dated by the calendar day of arrival at the final delivery stop, on the clock at that stop.

metrics.name: on_time_loads

dialects.expression: SUM(case when arrived_on_time then 1 else 0 end)

metrics.description: Delivered loads that arrived at the final delivery stop at or before the end of the appointment window, on the facility's local clock. Arriving early is on time. The top of the official on-time rate.

metrics.name: on_time_measured_loads

dialects.expression: SUM(case when arrived_on_time or not shipper_delayed then 1 else 0 end)

metrics.description: Delivered loads that count in the official on-time rate. A load that arrived late and has a delay the shipper caused is left out. The bottom of the official on-time rate.

metrics.name: on_time_rate

dialects.expression: 100 * SUM(case when arrived_on_time then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(SUM(case when arrived_on_time or not shipper_delayed then 1 else 0 end), 0)

metrics.description: Tessaway's official on-time delivery rate, the one its customer contracts define, as a percentage from 0 to 100: on-time loads divided by measured loads, over delivered loads. A load that arrived late and has a delay the shipper caused is left out of the measure, top and bottom; it is neither on time nor late.

metrics.name: late_deliveries

dialects.expression: SUM(case when not arrived_on_time and not shipper_delayed then 1 else 0 end)

metrics.description: Delivered loads that were late under the official on-time rule: arrival at the final delivery stop after the end of the appointment window, on the facility's local clock. A late load with a delay the shipper caused is left out; it is neither on time nor late.

metrics.name: operations_on_time_rate

dialects.expression: 100 * SUM(case when arrived_on_time then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(SUM(1), 0)

metrics.description: Not the official rate. What operations watches, as a percentage from 0 to 100: arrival inside the appointment window for every delivered load, shipper-caused or not.

metrics.name: portal_on_time_rate

dialects.expression: 100 * SUM(case when portal_on_time then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(SUM(1), 0)

metrics.description: Not the official rate. What customers see in the customer portal, as a percentage from 0 to 100: shipments delivered on or before the date the customer requested. It compares dates, not appointment times, and knows nothing about who caused a delay. It is the right answer only when the question is about what customers see in the portal. Dated by the delivery date the portal shows.

metrics.name: portal_shipments
metrics.description: Shipments the customer portal shows as delivered. Dated by the delivery date the portal shows.

metrics.name: portal_on_time_shipments

dialects.expression: SUM(case when portal_on_time then 1 else 0 end)

metrics.description: Shipments the customer portal shows as delivered on or before the date the customer requested.

metrics.name: delivered_loads_not_billable

dialects.expression: SUM(case when not has_signed_pod then 1 else 0 end)

metrics.description: Delivered loads that cannot be invoiced, because no signed proof of delivery is on file. For billing, delivered is not enough: an unsigned document does not count. Test loads are never billed and are not waiting on anything.

metrics.name: customers_shipped
metrics.description: Customers that shipped with us: parent accounts with at least one load delivered in the period. A shipping site is not a customer and a bill-to party is not a customer.

metrics.name: revenue
metrics.description: Revenue in US dollars, recognized when it is invoiced: invoice totals (which already include linehaul, fuel surcharge and accessorial charges billed to the customer) in the period of the invoice date, less credit memos in the period of the credit date, plus canceled-load fees billed to the customer in the period of the fee date. Canadian-dollar amounts are converted at the monthly rate for the month of the document. The rated linehaul on a tender is not revenue.

metrics.name: carrier_cost
metrics.description: What was paid to carriers, in US dollars: for an invoiced load, linehaul pay plus the carrier's fuel surcharge plus accessorials paid to the carrier, in the period the load's invoice was cut; and the carrier's share of a canceled-load fee, in the period of the fee date. Loads hauled by Tessaway's own fleet are treated the same way.

metrics.name: margin
metrics.description: Margin in US dollars: revenue less what was paid to carriers for the same loads.

metrics.name: invoiced_loads

dialects.expression: SUM(case when document_type = 'invoice' then 1 else 0 end)

metrics.description: The number of loads invoiced, in the period of the invoice date.

metrics.name: margin_per_load

dialects.expression: (SUM(financial_documents.revenue_usd) - SUM(financial_documents.carrier_cost_usd)) / nullif(SUM(case when document_type = 'invoice' then 1 else 0 end), 0)

metrics.description: Margin for the period divided by the number of loads invoiced in the period, in US dollars.

metrics.name: margin_percentage
metrics.description: Margin divided by revenue, as a percentage from 0 to 100.
